context:
Goal: build Card in Hand on the Duo with no surprises.
Problem: today the late-mail flag skips packages that have tracking. The past-transit page could follow that rule or list them too.
Based on: lostMail in src/view-rules.mjs skips tracked packages (read 14:35).
Meanwhile: Duo files your earlier answers. No build lane starts.
holds: Duo's Card in Hand build waits on this.

options.how: Tracked packages stay off the past-transit page.
options.label: No, same as the late flag today
options.lose: A tracked package that's stuck isn't listed.

options.how: Every package past 14 days shows, tracked or not.
options.label: Yes, list them too

ref: Duo build plan, duo-build-plan.md (8 lanes, 3 waves)
title: Should a tracked package more than 14 days late show on the past-transit page?
why: It keeps one late rule across the app.
